units.source_text: 不过，岛村没有在穿绉纱的仲夏，也没有在织绉纱的严冬来过这个温泉浴场，从而也就没有机会同驹子谈起绉纱的事。

en.t: However, Shimamura had never come to this hot spring resort in midsummer, when crepe was worn, nor in the depths of winter, when crepe was woven, and so he had never had the chance to talk with Komako about crepe.

units.source_text: 再说，他这个人也不像是去参观古代民间的艺术遗迹的。

en.t: Besides, he was not the sort of person to go visiting the remains of old folk art.

units.source_text: 然而，岛村听了叶子在浴池放声歌唱，忽然想到：这个姑娘若生在那个时代，恐怕也会守在纺纱车或织布机旁这样放声歌唱的吧。

en.t: Yet when Shimamura heard Yoko singing at the top of her voice in the bath, it suddenly occurred to him that if this girl had been born in that age, she too might have sung like this beside a spinning wheel or a loom.

units.source_text: 叶子的歌声确实像那样一种声音。

en.t: Yoko's singing voice truly had that kind of sound.
